name: Gilded Rim Dinner Set - 12 Piece
shortDescription: Twelve pieces of quiet drama — cream stoneware kissed with gold, made for hosts whose dinners linger long after dessert.
description: Serve a table that glows. This twelve-piece set pairs soft cream stoneware with a fine gold rim, chosen for the way it catches candlelight. Made for slow dinners, gifting, and every occasion worth dressing for. Enquire for availability and gifting options.
